title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
keyIdea: Each node has 26 child links and a flag "a word ends here". insert walks the letters, creating missing nodes, then sets the flag. search needs the full path and the flag; startsWith only needs the full path.

approaches.name: Hash sets of words and prefixes
approaches.idea: Store every word, and every prefix of every word, in two sets.
approaches.why: Each insert creates and hashes L prefixes of length up to L.

approaches.name: Trie with 26 links per node
approaches.idea: links[ch − 'a'] moves down one letter; flag marks word ends.
approaches.why: One step per letter; shared prefixes share nodes.

quiz.q: After insert("apple"), why is search("app") false?
options: The path a-p-p exists, but no word ends there: its flag is false
search only checks the first letter

quiz.q: What is the only difference between search and startsWith?
options: search returns node->flag at the end; startsWith returns true

quiz.q: Why does a trie save work for words with a common prefix?
options: They share the same nodes for that prefix
